reviewIntro: Update one item at a time. Unknown does not mean zero.
stale: Included, needs a date or update · {{count}}
staleHelp: These known values still count. Their dates are unknown or more than 90 days old; they may no longer be current.
missingValueHelp: No amount is added for these items. Your total does not represent their value.
missingRateHelp: These amounts cannot be added to your total until you enter a conversion rate.
clearReview: No missing values, missing rates or values needing a date review were found. This is not a live valuation.
pictureSummary: Known assets minus known debts: {{amount}}. This is an estimate of your recorded position, not cash available to spend.
pictureIncomplete: Some items are excluded below. The total is incomplete, not a full measure of everything you own and owe.
pictureKnown: Only recorded values with a known conversion rate are included. Values are entered by you, not live prices.
downloadHelp: PDF for reading, CSV for a spreadsheet, JSON for restoring your full picture. Keep backups somewhere private.
localRisk: Clearing browser data or changing devices can lose this copy. Anyone using this browser profile may be able to see it. Keep a private backup.
accountsUnavailable: Cloud accounts are not available here yet. You can keep using browser records and download a backup. Early-access registration is separate.
sampleTitle: Explore the example, or build your own picture
sampleHelp: New personal items cannot be added to example records. Starting your picture replaces this browser’s labelled sample with an empty list. Existing personal records in other browsers are not changed.
sampleConfirm: Replace this browser’s labelled sample with an empty personal picture? Your draft, if any, stays open. No other browser or cloud records will change.
sampleEdit: You are editing an example. It stays labelled as sample data.
chooseType: What would you like to add?
chooseHelp: Choose something you own or owe. You do not need a ticker or a live price.
reviewHelp: Nothing has been saved yet. Go back to change anything.
entryDateHelp: For a known value, use its actual estimate or statement date. For an unknown value, this is the record date—not a valuation.
equity: I own a share of a business
gift: It was a gift · not an asset
accessibleHelp: Items you marked as accessible—not a spending allowance. Debts and other commitments may still need to be paid.
teamWarning: These links are not access protection. The outreach prototype exposes aggregate counts only.
falcGuidance: Start with one item. You can edit the draft below; I will never guess a missing amount.
falcDate: Choose the actual value date in the draft
falcSample: Start your own picture to save this draft. The draft stays here; the example list is replaced only if you confirm.
falcValue: enter a current value, or choose to leave it unknown
falcGold: enter the gold weight and purity
falcIpo: choose whether shares have been allocated
falcReady: The draft is ready for your final review. Check every detail before confirming.
